record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: contract validates with evidence-observation; with a store, verdict records and trail lists while a subsequent verdict still passes; without a store, verdict stdout/exit are unchanged; phase tests for the touched files pass.

## Approach

Run each verify_command from the acceptances only. Do not edit the tree; if a check fails return `fail` with the output.
record.subject: verify-evidence-interface
